title: Heart attack and stroke warning signs
text: Central chest pain or discomfort, pain extending to the arm, shoulder, jaw or back, breathing difficulty, faintness, or cold sweat can accompany heart attack. Sudden one-sided weakness, speech or vision difficulty, loss of balance, severe unexplained headache, fainting, or unconsciousness can indicate stroke and require immediate medical care.

title: Stroke requires emergency response
text: Sudden one-sided face, arm or leg weakness or numbness; confusion or speech difficulty; sudden vision or walking difficulty; loss of balance; or a sudden severe unexplained headache are stroke warning signs. Emergency services should be contacted immediately.
source: CDC Signs and Symptoms of Stroke — https://www.cdc.gov/stroke/signs-symptoms/index.html
